gloss: omission (in a document); failure to include

definitions.gloss: omission; failure to include in a document; something left out of a written record
definitions.explanation: An item or piece of information that should have been written down or recorded but was accidentally left out. Commonly used in business and administrative contexts.

examples.japanese: {書類|しょるい}に{記載漏|きさいも}れがあった。
examples.english: There was an omission in the document.

examples.japanese: {記載漏|きさいも}れがないか、もう{一度|いちど}{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please check once more to make sure nothing was left out.

examples.japanese: {申込書|もうしこみしょ}の{記載漏|きさいも}れがあると、{手続|てつづ}きが{遅|おく}れることがあります。
examples.english: If there are omissions on the application form, the processing may be delayed.

notes:
USAGE:
The suffix ～{漏|も}れ (from {漏|も}れる, to leak/be missing) is productive for expressing something that was missed or overlooked: {確認漏|かくにんも}れ (failure to check), {連絡漏|れんらくも}れ (failure to notify).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {記載漏|きさいも}れがある (there is an omission)
- {記載漏|きさいも}れがないか{確認|かくにん}する (to check for omissions)
- {記載漏|きさいも}れに{注意|ちゅうい}する (to be careful about omissions)
